20160101.text: Repeat after me. "Three, two, one, one, two, three, ahhhh, ahhhh." Come on.

20160103.text: Okay, that's positive. Your brain seems relatively unscathed, this is good news.

20160106.text: It's just as well, really, with the amount of effort it took me to get you back here. Honestly, it was like you were glued to the ground back there.

20160107.text: Uh, Miko, Paimon's been wanting to ask you about something. How come you're acting so differently from when we first met you?

20160108.text: Am I? Maybe it's because I had the other shrine maidens leave. Anyway, I've always been like this.

20160109.text: People show you whatever side of themselves they want you to see. I know this for a fact.

20160110.text: Every side of me is the real me. People just like to define things in all sorts of arbitrary ways.

20160111.text: This is a human society — at the moment, anyway — and I'm just doing as I please.

20160113.text: Hehe, study humans a while longer, my little friend. You'll see what I mean.

20160105.text: Oh? You recognized me right away. Your brain seems relatively unscathed, this is good news.

20160601.text: We're gonna do it here? And what's this <color=#00E1FFFF>mechanism</color> for?

20160602.text: Think of it as a catalyst that can reproduce the Raiden Shogun's combat moves. I made it from my own memory, which means it should be perfectly accurate — unless of course, her skills have declined.

20160603.text: It'll give you a chance to figure out her moves in advance and come up with a counter strategy. That should be a big help, don't you think?

20160604.text: The aim is to try not to get hit by the attacks. Since you've escaped certain death at her hand once already, I presume this shouldn't be more than you can handle?

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the Anti-Raiden Shogun Training (on any difficulty)

20160704.text: So how come you know so much about the Raiden Shogun?

20160706.text: Perhaps it's because... I'm the Electro Archon's familiar.

20160707.text: What!? Like Dvalin is to Barbatos? Never would have guessed by looking at you...

20160708.text: Hehe, it sounds like you'd be more persuaded if you saw me in my fox form?

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the next phase of your Anti-Raiden Shogun Training

20160301.text: So how come you know so much about the Raiden Shogun?

20160303.text: Perhaps it's because... I'm the Electro Archon's familiar.

20160304.text: What!? Like Dvalin is to Barbatos? Never would have guessed by looking at you...

20160305.text: Hehe, it sounds like you'd be more persuaded if you saw me in my fox form?

20160310.text: More curious than my appearance is the fact that she and I don't see each other anymore, wouldn't you say?

20160311.text: "A nation to last for all eternity" is a dream that she and I both share. But I don't think that's the same thing as complete stasis.

20160312.text: At some point, she started going down a path that became increasingly difficult for me to join her on.

20160313.text: You know, Ei never said goodbye to me before she stepped into the Plane of Euthymia.

20160314.text: Perhaps it's just my wishful thinking, but I think she did this deliberately, as her way of keeping our friendship eternal.

20160315.text: By neither saying goodbye nor seeing me again, our relationship will remain forever how it was... in her mind, at least.

20160401.text: Phew... we're finally done. How did we do?

20160402.text: You did quite admirably. I could see your determination and your hard work.

20160403.text: So do you think we're ready to beat the Raiden Shogun now?

20160404.text: How do I put this... you're no match for her at all.

20160405.text: Wait, what!? So all of this was a complete waste of time!?

20160406.text: Hehe. You are the most important part of the plan. I know what I'm doing. You don't think I'd leave you with no chance to win at all, do you?

20160407.text: Speaking of... Traveler, what do you think of the resistance army's chances?

20160410.text: Hah, you're absolutely right. Perhaps they occasionally best the Shogun's Army in open battle, but when they face the Raiden Shogun herself...

20160411.text: Considering even their Visions have been taken from them and embedded in the Statue, they are ultimately quite helpless.

20160412.text: You don't have to be so blunt. The Traveler's the captain of Swordfish II, y'know!

20160413.text: Hehe. I don't mean to belittle them. On the contrary...

20160414.text: It is precisely because of their helplessness, because their Visions have been taken from them, that their will is all the more precious.

20160415.text: In short, if everything goes according to plan, they may yet prove to be helpful.

20160417.text: Oh... goodness, is that the time? I have another guest to receive today. We can talk more back at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Grand Narukami Shrine</color>.

20160418.text: All of a sudden you're entertaining guests!? Paimon's really struggling to understand how you work...

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Grand Narukami Shrine and talk to Yae Miko

20160501.text: Okay, we can talk here. You asked me about the plan — in fact, I've been mulling it over for quite a long time.

20160502.text: Before one makes a plan, what is the most important thing one must do?

20160504.text: You must understand the situation you are facing.

20160505.text: The Vision Hunt Decree was obviously devised as a means of manipulating the Shogun, the ones behind it knowing full well her susceptibility as a puppet with a single-minded focus on eternity.

20160508.text: Yes. This is the strongest piece of evidence we have to go on.

20160509.text: Now, we also know that every aspect of the Vision Hunt Decree's promulgation and execution has been enthusiastically spearheaded by the Tenryou Commission from the outset.

20160510.text: Ayaka was saying that every time they submitted a petition against the Vision Hunt Decree, the Tenryou and Kanjou Commissions would veto it straight away with no negotiation.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Grand Narukami Shrine and talk to Yae Miko

20155001.text: Hmm? What's stopping you? Not still traumatized from your last encounter, are you?

20155101.text: If you get hit by the Musou no Hitotachi, that's it. It's game over. I would get training if I were you.

400807001.text: Well, that was an interesting poem.

400807003.text: Hehe... I am your teacher, after all. It wouldn't be much good if my mind couldn't keep up with my students'.

400807004.text: But you should understand it however it makes sense to you. My little wolf cub will improve much more quickly that way.

400807101.text: Ah, I'm much more suited to leisurely days like these...

400807105.text: I'd love to, cutie. Hmm, too bad I can't offer you some tea.

400807104.text: Alright, but remember, it's important to rest when you're feeling tired. It makes my heart ache to see you so busy all the time.

400807201.text: I didn't expect you to come by here. Unless... oh, were you following the fragrance of wine on the wind?

400807205.text: Sure, the sound of your voice is always a pleasure to hear.

400807204.text: Then go, my friend. The stories that unfolded here shall be remembered by the wind in the form of verse.

400807304.text: Okay. You go enjoy the wind.

400807401.text: So, what do you think of the Weinlesefest? Have you enjoyed yourself?

400807405.text: Well, what would you like to know?

400807404.text: Sure. We'll talk when you're free.

400807505.text: Sure. Did you have something you wanted to ask me about?

400807504.text: Alright. But don't tell anyone else that I'm here. I don't want to have to move anytime soon.

400807601.text: Hi there, are you here to take a look at my stall? I have a lot of newly developed research products.

400880101.text: Are you here to set up a booth, too?

400880102.text: The wine market is being held outside of Springvale this time. Not only is the scenery gorgeous, but delivering goods there is pretty convenient.

400880103.text: But since we — that is, Angel's Share — have a large booth, it takes quite a long time to get everything set up.

400880201.text: Would you like something to drink? Not only are we selling wine, but we are also acquiring all kinds of wine-making ingredients during the festival. You're welcome to come around and discuss anything you're interested in.

400880301.text: Forest boars make regular appearances during the harvest season, so you have to take extra care when delivering goods.

400880302.text: The Knight of Favonius and Springvale's hunters have already come up with a plan to drive the forest boars off. I hear that a youth who can talk to wolves will come and help as well...

400880401.text: Welcome to Weinlesefest! If there's anything you need help with, please contact the Knights of Favonius.

400880403.text: Well, speaking of that, there's actually no requirement a location has to meet to host it. This celebratory event has been held in Mondstadt City itself several times before as well.

400880404.text: But personally, I prefer the site that they selected this year. Compared to the hustle and bustle of the city, Cider Lake has prettier scenery and a more rustic charm.

400880406.text: As one of the festival's sponsors, the Knights of Favonius will maintain order on-site while ensuring that every guest will enjoy the festivities to the fullest.

400880407.text: As such, I'd also like to remind our guests to drink in moderation! Over-drinking and bothering other guests will result in a visit from us.

400880501.text: Sorry, but Diona will be on leave for the duration of the festival... Oh, you're not here to see Diona? That's rare.

400880601.text: Come and buy some fresh fruit! All of them are freshly picked and suitable for eating or wine-making!

400880602.text: I'll let you in on a little secret — at least half of the apples that Dawn Winery uses to make their Apple Cider come from us.

400880701.text: "Our booth sells old books that the library regularly phases out. These books will not have missing pages and will not be torn, but they may show signs of age. Thanks for your understanding."

400880702.text: "All books are on sale at half price. All proceeds will go towards the total earnings of the Knights of Favonius' charity sale, which will be used to help Mondstadt residents in need."

400880703.text: "The vendor is out on business. Please take any books you need and place the money in the wooden box under the booth."

400880801.text: All your general goods sold here at affordable prices, come and take a look!

400880803.text: Well, if it isn't the Honorary Knight! It's a pleasure to meet you!

400880804.text: I was doing business abroad previously, and I normally only come back during Weinlesefest. It's no surprise that we haven't met before.

400880805.text: If it's meant to be, I'm sure we'll meet again elsewhere!

400880808.text: As you can see, Weinlesefest is swarming with guests! I can make as much in one day here as I normally would in four or five!

400880809.text: I wish there were more lively festivals like this one!

400880811.text: See you, may we meet again!

400880901.text: We sell all sorts of fresh flowers and plants here — looking to buy a few bouquets?

400880905.text: But I'm a resident of Springvale, and I run a small flower shop.

400880906.text: I'm always busy looking after the flowers and plants, so I haven't had any dealings with visitors from outside the town in a long time...

400880907.text: I never thought I'd meet a celebrity like you this year. Perhaps it's good luck brought by the returning wind?

400880909.text: I'm a keen gardener — the plants you see here? I grew them all myself. They're less common varieties that are purely ornamental.

400880910.text: My hope is that such beautiful plants will lift everyone's spirits.

400880911.text: However, because of their seasonal nature, I can only open for business at certain times of the year.

400881001.text: I'm a winemaker from Sailing Breeze. I came to this market specifically to purchase ingredients.

400881002.text: You haven't heard of us at all? Heh, that's no surprise. We're an old brand, but we primarily do business overseas these days. We don't even have a shop in Mondstadt anymore.

400881003.text: We can't compete with Dawn Winery, but Sailing Breeze has made quite a name for itself in Inazuma.

400881004.text: That girl Karpillia was so desperate to expand into the overseas market, but it was the right call in the end.

400881005.text: Thanks to her, my skills can still be put to good use even now.

400881101.text: Weinlesefest is the best festival for bards!

400881102.text: Sampling fine wines while singing your heart out. This is the life of a bard, and that's how it's supposed to be.

400881103.text: It's the perfect festival for getting those creative juices flowing. I really hope my poet friends from Inazuma can come and check it out as well.

400881201.text: Yo, Honorary Knight! Would you like to hear good news from the shop?

400881203.text: Haha, let me break it down for you, and you can tell me what you think!

400881204.text: Thank you for your hard work!

400881205.text: Saying that will out you as an outsider! It's not hard work, it's a good time!

400881301.text: Hello, do you have any new tasks?

400881303.text: You'll be pleased to know that business has been doing great recently.

400881305.text: Thanks! I feel fulfilled to be able to do something for the elderly and the children!

400881401.text: You're here! Would you like an update? Or, do you have a new business strategy?

400881403.text: Everything is going well. Please listen to the business briefing!

400881405.text: No worries, it's my honor to contribute to the charity sale!

400881501.text: Yo, I heard the charity sale was a great success. Congratulations, Honorary Knight!

400881504.text: This event has invigorated me. We didn't make money, but we had more fun than ever.

400881505.text: I guess it's the satisfaction of doing a good deed.

400881507.text: Sure! I'm about to leave, too!

400881508.text: Next time I'll be sure to try harder!

400881601.text: Honorary Knight, word around town is that the charity sale was a runaway success, all thanks to you, Paimon, Bernhard, and Mats!

400881602.text: Even I got a taste of the limelight, getting a few "thank you" notes of my own...

400881604.text: I haven't done enough, not as much as you guys.

400881605.text: However, after listening to your business strategy, I felt I have learned a lot and have become a more skilled businesswoman!

400881608.text: Please make sure to look for me when you get the chance.

400881701.text: I'll take care of the shop's set-up. You two can focus on preparing the necessary funds!

400881703.text: You could help nearby customers place orders with the wine merchants or supply winemakers with ingredients...

400881704.text: Either method is fine, so you can just prioritize based on your preference.

400881706.text: Well... The person in charge was determined by a random draw mechanism that was intended to give each Knight an equal chance... to facilitate dialogue between us and the public...

400881707.text: I can do my usual work just fine. But when it comes to deciding on a direction or coming up with a plan, I'm always afraid that I'll make a mess of things...

400881708.text: So, it's a good thing that you, our Honorary Knight, have stepped up to the plate! You could say that you saved this charity event — not to mention me!

400881710.text: Okay! I'm looking forward to hearing the good news from you.

400882001.text: I'd like to buy some beverages.

400882101.text: I'd like to sell wine-making ingredients.

400882102.text: Sure, these are the ingredients that we're buying at the moment.

400882202.text: Angel's Share participates in Weinlesefest each time, and plenty of folk come all the way here to Mondstadt to sample our limited-edition wines.

400882203.text: Back when Master Crepus was around, he'd come to us in person every year to drink a glass...

400882204.text: *sigh* I don't know why, but this festival always makes me nostalgic.

400882205.text: Diluc... I mean, Master Diluc has had a rough go of it these past few years, but he seems to be in good spirits this year.

400882206.text: As long as Master Diluc is well, I'm sure Master Crepus' spirit up above will also be pleased.

400882302.text: See you. Come back any time!

400883001.text: Honorary Knight, Paimon, you've been running the shop for a while.

400883002.text: The current operation method of the store refers to the previous business activities, which is fine, but may not be applicable in all cases.

400883003.text: You are well informed and can think about your unique "business style" based on your experience with other business people.

400883004.text: Oh! Is this what Bernhard meant earlier when he mentioned "Shop Stratagems"?

400883007.text: Okay! Then do whatever you feel is best, and I will do my best to carry out your orders!

400883008.text: At the same time, I will also help collect the experience of other businessmen and provide it to you.

400883009.text: I hope these notes will inspire you and give you new ideas!

400883101.text: Honorary Knight and Paimon, the "owner's assessment" is here. Please cooperate with me!

400883103.text: Sounds a bit like a legal examination. Are we supposed to fill out a... super-complicated answer sheet?

400883104.text: No no no. No need to be so formal. I just need your verbal answers!

400883105.text: Our store was in a special situation, and Leah was supposed to be inspecting me, but I already knew the entire safety manual by heart.

400883106.text: You two are in charge now, so Leah asked me to check you out on her behalf.

400883107.text: All you have to do is answer two questions and prove that you are safety-aware. I believe in you guys!

400883108.text: You can also get a reward if you answer correctly.

400883109.text: Paimon was really nervous about the test just now! Well, now it sounds pretty simple.

400883112.text: "If a known alcoholic suddenly shows up in front of your shop intoxicated, what do you do?"

400883116.text: Well... the correct answer is "call the Knights of Favonius for support to prevent the other party from getting into a drunken accident"...

400883117.text: Still, according to the Honorary Knight's thinking, if it can fuddle even an alcoholic like that, it must be no ordinary drink.

400883118.text: Its stock is bound to be limited. If we join in, we can cut down on inventory in other stores.

400883119.text: Plus, there's another place on the market that sells it. It reduces the likelihood that drinkers will drink too much in one store.

400883120.text: Amazing! Thinking longer-term is indeed something more fitting for the Honorary Knight!

400883121.text: #Bernhard... This logic is so complicated... You don't have to work so hard to bail {NICKNAME} out...

400883123.text: "Items for sale are often boxed up and stacked, posing a fire hazard. As a shopkeeper, what measures would you take to prevent fire hazards?"

400883201.text: You two! We've got a problem!

400883202.text: An unidentified man came quietly into the store, leaving a package and a letter.

400883203.text: The man said in his letter that he had heard about our charity sale, and remembered his financial hardships as a child. He was very touched.

400883204.text: He wanted every child to grow up happy, so he donated some Fairbrew Jelly and other goods for sale.

400883205.text: This is the first time this has happened to us! Paimon's a little moved...

400883206.text: But... why would he hide his identity?

400883207.text: Maybe this guy has a low profile! Perhaps, doing good deeds without leaving a name also gives a special sense of accomplishment?

400883208.text: Maybe we should be more prudent...

400883209.text: I have heard that Treasure Hoarders have mixed counterfeit goods with ordinary goods for unsuspecting merchants to sell.

400883210.text: This way, they can successfully throw away the hot potato, and make Mora on the side.

400883211.text: Paimon can't believe it! Those horrible Treasure Hoarders, how can they even cheat innocent shop owners and customers!

400883212.text: #Paimon's suddenly a little nervous... {NICKNAME}, what do you think we should do with the package...

400883301.text: This will not affect the sales revenue.

400883302.text: Indeed, Knights of Favonius has done this before - auctioning off the loot of Treasure Hoarders to raise money for charity.

400883303.text: Even if the package's origins are questionable, it's all the same.

400883304.text: Come to think of it, the Treasure Hoarders wouldn't dare do this in a Knight of Favonius' shop, would they?

400883305.text: Besides, he just left the package and it didn't seem like he made half a Mora.

400883306.text: People who are willing to follow the charity sale must be very kind, and we don't have to be so nervous!

400883307.text: Then we'll take this package. I'll make a note of it and report it to the head office.

400883402.text: Yup, let's be on the safe side!

400883403.text: I'll take the package back to the Knights of Favonius and have it verified.

400883404.text: Bernhard took the package to the Knights of Favonius headquarters...

400883405.text: It's approved, Honorary Knight and Paimon! There was nothing wrong with the content of the package!

400883406.text: Captain Hertha told us not to worry. In previous years, people have made such anonymous donations at the charity sale.

400883407.text: But this is still a good reminder. Recently, we've been following the Treasure Hoarders very closely, and it's possible they could use this trick to get out of trouble.

400883408.text: When Captain Hertha heard about it, she also made a donation to the sale from her own pocket to show her encouragement.

400883409.text: Paimon sees... So the package is alright! Thanks to this mysterious kind soul. Paimon wishes him good fortune every day!

400883501.text: This won't do. There won't be any end to this...

400883502.text: What's wrong, Mats? What's up with the store?

400883503.text: It's an old problem. I have some daily necessities that have been shipped to my store, and they've been caught in the middle of the wind, waves, and tide.

400883504.text: I was hoping to dry them while we were open, in hopes that they would be ready to sell for cheap at the end of the festival.

400883505.text: But the sunshine in Mondstadt is too gentle, and we are here beside Cider Lake, where the air is humid. So far, nothing has gone as planned.

400883506.text: If it goes on like this, our daily necessities will get moldy.

400883507.text: Hmm... this is a bit tricky.

400883508.text: Maybe we can make a fire to dry the shipment... but that would be too dangerous... Bernhard and Leah would stop it.

400883601.text: You could try using Flaming Flower Stamens.

400883602.text: Yeah, that's a good idea. The Flaming Flower Stamens are really hot and should be able to dry them out in no time.

400883603.text: To be on the safe side, you can also put them in a large glass bottle, so you don't have to worry about fire spreading.

400883604.text: Good idea. I'll send someone to get the needed materials!

400883605.text: You two are very clever, and I am in your debt!

400883702.text: You mean blowing the goods dry with the strong wind from the Anemograna?

400883703.text: Hmm... The wind will be strong enough for sure, but won't it blow the goods away?

400883704.text: Perhaps we can tie the boxes together and increase their total weight that way!

400883705.text: Huh. That's not a bad idea! I'll send someone to find Anemograna right now, and I'll send all the supplies over.

400883706.text: Thank you both very much. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

400883801.text: Arranging flowers really is a science unto itself...

400883802.text: Are you running into any problems, Pauline?

400883803.text: It's not really a big deal.

400883804.text: Usually, I always sell flowers by variety, because I think they would be clear to customers at a glance...

400883805.text: But recently, I heard that combining several kinds of flowers can make them complement each other and look more beautiful.

400883806.text: I tried to match the different flowers, and although I don't quite understand how it works, the business of the shop during the festival is significantly more busy.

400883807.text: So I was wondering, how do you cultivate this particular kind of artistic sense? Do you have to find a professional mentor?

400883808.text: Hmm, what Pauline said is definitely something worth thinking about.

400883901.text: Go with something that matches your inspiration.

400883902.text: That's right, inspiration does work really well sometimes!

400883903.text: Y'know, you put some random flowers together and that made the store's business better, just like that!

400883904.text: And that means that you're plenty inspired. Just follow your heart from now on, and maybe you won't need a mentor at all!

400883905.text: Really? This is the first time I've ever been told that... I seemed to have hit my stride!

400883906.text: Thank you for your vote of confidence! I don't know what to say, but I'd like to thank you properly...

400883907.text: Here is a token of my gratitude. Please take it!

400884001.text: Go look for some reference books first.

400884002.text: Well... theory is the safest way to get started.

400884003.text: The Knights of Favonius' library has a large collection of books. You should be able to find something there, right?

400884004.text: Liyue and Inazuma also have knowledge on arranging flowers. If you get the chance, you can also try to get some books written there for reference.

400884005.text: I understand. I'll ask someone to help me get some books from the library once Weinlesefest ends.

400884006.text: As for reference books from Liyue and Inazuma, I should be able to ask Mats. He travels a lot.

400884007.text: Hehe, maybe the next time we meet, you'll have become a master at arranging flowers!

400884008.text: I'll do my best. Your suggestions are really valuable. Thank you very much!

400884009.text: Here is a token of my gratitude. Please take it!

400884101.text: Honorary Knight. Paimon. There's one more thing for you to decide.

400884102.text: Alright, alright. We'll help. What do you need?

400884103.text: The peak time of Weinlesefest will soon be over. Some shopkeepers estimate that they will have some surplus in stock and plan to donate to us.

400884104.text: Isn't that a good thing? "Surplus stock" sounds like a bad thing, but they seem to mean well.

400884105.text: We might not be able to sell it all.

400884106.text: The Honorary Knight has a good point. Our ability to sell is also limited.

400884107.text: After these goods are donated to us, we might not be able to sell them, and they might accumulate.

400884108.text: Some of the daily necessities and food would soon go bad, which would be a waste of good intentions.

400884109.text: #Hmm! Paimon didn't think about that. {NICKNAME} always seems to know best!

400884201.text: Perhaps we should politely decline after explaining our reasons.

400884202.text: Understood. I'll talk to the owners.

400884203.text: Bernhard leaves to talk to the people involved...

400884204.text: Honorary Knight. Paimon. The owners were very reasonable and understood our reply.

400884205.text: However, the shopkeepers did donate a sum of money to show their support for the charity sale.

400884207.text: Anyway, it is fortunate that nothing went to waste this time!

400884301.text: Could it be resold to the Knights of Favonius?

400884302.text: This is indeed a method, and sometimes, the Knights will spontaneously count their personal needs.

400884303.text: If residents have used goods that they are willing to sell, and the knights do not mind, they can make a deal directly to reduce the waste of materials.

400884304.text: In the same way, the inhabitants could speak directly to the knights if they need something.

400884305.text: Maybe someone recently wanted to buy something, but didn't realize that these owners had a lot of stuff they couldn't sell.

400884306.text: Alright! Well, it's up to you to bridge the gap, Bernhard.

400884307.text: Bernhard leaves for the Order to look at the purchase needs...

400884309.text: It just so happens that a lot of people want to buy used goods these days, and they can resell most of the surplus goods to them.

400884310.text: Some of the knights also chipped in to pay for our hard work.

400884311.text: Okay! The thrift crisis is solved, and everyone's needs are met!

400885001.text: I'd like to sell wine-making ingredients.

400885002.text: One moment please, let me have a look around for Miss Margaret's acquisition list. Now, where did I put it...

400885102.text: Yes, Miss Diona's mood tends to sour when Weinlesefest comes around, so Miss Margaret gave her some time off.

400885103.text: But that's understandable. After all, the number of booze hounds at the wine market far exceeds that which you might find at the tavern.

400885104.text: As for Miss Margaret, she certainly wouldn't pass up the festivities just to run the business. She's probably off somewhere drinking and having a good time as we speak.

400887002.text: ... It's you again, you're not gonna drag me into giving you another discount, are you?

400887003.text: Before you say anything, I'm way too busy for this Weinlesefest!

400887004.text: Even if you're busy, you shouldn't forget about me!

400887005.text: No matter fruit or fruit wine, for the sake of childhood friendship, can't you get me a discount?

400887006.text: I've told you many times, the fruit is not on sale. And I'm just helping deliver fruit to the drink stands. How can you insist on a discount?

400887007.text: Come on, hook a sister up!

400887008.text: I know you love wine. I'll get some and share with you. Then I'll help you make some refreshments. Could you just give me a discount?

400887009.text: No discounts. No matter what you say!

400887102.text: Weinlesefest is an autumn festival to celebrate the harvest of the Mondstadters. We use the fruits of the harvest to make drinks to dedicate to the Anemo Archon. He will then bless everyone with the West Wind.

400887103.text: That said, for Mondstadters, it doesn't matter whether Lord Barbatos actually shows up or not. The festival is just a good time to drink lots of wine.

400887104.text: Although drunk people are troublesome, I can't really say anything when I see nothing but uplifted spirits from drinking.

400887105.text: After all, everyone has worked hard all year and deserves a good celebration.

400887201.text: Weinlesefest... is truly an amazing festival!

400887202.text: If it never ended, everyone would be able to have Dawn Winery's Weinlesefest specialty every day...

400887203.text: Eh, I really needed this to relax and forget about that nag...

400887501.text: Welcome to Floral Whisper. Do you need anything?

400887502.text: Recently, everyone asked what flower best represents the happiness of harvest. Hehe, I think Dandelion is suitable.

400887701.text: Come in, come in! We are having a special Weinlesefest discount at Angel's Share!

400887702.text: If you pass by Springvale, don't forget to stop by our stand and have a look!

400887802.text: Oh? You've already met my brother? Then I don't think there's much to say.

400887803.text: I was so worried about him when he went out with the Grand Master. But now it seems I was too worried.

400887804.text: Although he is still prone to shyness, his ability to survey and do mapping has improved a lot, and his work is done in short order.

400887805.text: I hear he's joining the Guerrilla Assault platoon next, and he probably won't be back in town for a while. I wish him all the best!

400887901.text: Welcome to Mondstadt, Traveler. Please enjoy Weinlesefest.

400888001.text: The happier everyone in town is, the more meaningless my day seems...

400888002.text: Weinlesefest. My father must be busy... What am I doing here? I might as well be at home helping.

400888101.text: Happy Weinlesefest! The Knights of Favonius are holding a charity sale at Cider Lake. All residents and visitors are welcome to participate!

400888201.text: Hey, kiddo! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild!

400888202.text: At the invitation of the Librarian, members of the Adventurers' Guild are expected to participate in Weinlesefest as well.

400888203.text: Enjoy the wine, enjoy the adventure and help all those in need! This is the spirit of our adventurers, haha!

400888301.text: Have you heard the wind of Windcoming Day?

400888302.text: It must be Lord Barbatos who has returned to the homeland with a breeze and has given his blessing to Monddstadt!

400888303.text: Lord Barbatos, please enjoy our wine and give your blessing to Mondstadt...

400888401.text: *sigh* It's Weinlesefest, but Diona is nowhere to be found.

400888402.text: After all, she is especially upset when it comes to times like this. In order to ensure that she's still with us, we decided to let her take a couple days off.

400888403.text: So... would you like to buy me a special Weinlesefest drink?

400888501.text: Holidays when one can have a proper drink are such a rare occasion! Why don't we take a detour and buy some liquid refreshments... or maybe take a trip to Springvale?

400888601.text: I've never heard your voice before... Are you a traveler who came here to participate in Weinlesefest?

400888602.text: Welcome. I hope you enjoy the festival as much as I do.

400888603.text: Although I can't see to celebrate with everyone else, this festival brings me the best news of all: that all is well with the Knights of Favonius' expedition...

400888701.text: Are you here for the limited-edition festival wine, too? Let's drink together. Come, come, have a seat!

400888702.text: I wouldn't have expected less from the Dawn Winery's products. Every year, it arrives with the west wind and just gets more and more fragrant.

400888801.text: Hello friend. Have you heard of the ballad of the Windcoming Day?

400888802.text: The song of this festival is not only beautiful, but also seems to have a hidden deeper meaning.

400888803.text: Like the secret to a good wine, it also contains the meaning of life... Mmm, that's good material.

400888902.text: Ah, so you heard... Elzer is the executive chairman of the Mondstadt Wine Guild.

400888903.text: This year, the Knights of Favonius, in collaboration with the Church of Favonius and the Adventurers' Guild, is hosting a Wine Market and are in need of a special budget.

400888904.text: However, Elzer invited me to collaborate and he helped us solve a lot of our financial problems.

400888905.text: Although he didn't say it explicitly... But my guess is that this grant came at the behest of a once senior Knight of Favonius.

400889001.text: Oh? Distinguished guest, may I ask, are you here to discuss business?

400889002.text: If it's for Weinlesefest, I've got Master's permission to do what I can to help.

400889102.text: Looks like he's doing pretty well recently. Though he laughed all the way through dinner with Master Diluc, I could see that he was worried...

400889103.text: If you're asking about the title, that's all in the past...

400889104.text: Sorry, that was a slip of the tongue... Please forget I ever said that.

400889201.text: Hello, Traveler. There's a big festival going on in Cider Lake, and there's been a lot more tourists in town lately.

400889202.text: The festival is going well! My daughter is on a break, so I get to spend more time with her.

400889301.text: I don't know if it's because his daughter is on break or what, but Draff has been extra jolly these days and is drinking even harder after work...

400889302.text: It's a good thing that young one has been helping out lately, or I wouldn't be able to stand up if I had to hunt all by myself.

400889401.text: Traveler! It's you! Welcome to Mondstadt's Weinlesefest.

400889402.text: I really miss it... Although there seem to be few people brewing the "Thousand-Wind Wine" now, the return of the west wind is still so familiar...

400889502.text: Oh, Marla! I can't turn my back on you, not when you're inviting me to Weinlesefest!

400889503.text: No matter what your father thinks of us, my love... is like wine made from Mist Flowers...

400889504.text: Marla, no... Your love should not be a thing so cold...

400889505.text: No. I mean that, my love will turn into burning liquor to warm you for a thousand — nay, for ten thousand years...

400889506.text: Oh, Marla, my love! Then my love for you is like the bitter north wind that follows the west wind...

400889507.text: Marvin, no... Your love should not be a thing so chilly...

400889508.text: No. I mean that, I don't want you out of my sight, not even for a moment. I want to turn into a full season of Mondstadt's wind, always by your side...

616390502.text: Master Goth pays me to protect his young esquire. His young esquire pays me to keep this a secret from his old man.

616390503.text: To get paid double, I just have to stay put and keep my mouth shut.

616390504.text: Hmph, look at them. Being all lovey-dovey when I'm right here watching. Young people these days, no sense of shame...

616390505.text: Wait a second... Are they getting a kick out of me watching them!?

709090102.text: Of course. After chasing the monsters away, I have absolutely nothing to do.

709090103.text: Earlier, the young master asked me to help him pick some flowers, but he and that young lady started getting all lovey-dovey right away...

709090104.text: What need do they have for flowers? I reckon the young master's forgotten all about it already.

709090105.text: Do you want them? Just take them if you do. They're no use to me, anyhow.
